home.tech.title: One codebase, three databases
home.statement.strong: An admin framework, delivered as source.
home.statement.rest: Every line of shared code stays readable, modifiable and upgradable — you own the whole system, not just its UI.
home.product.title: This is the actual admin
home.product.sub: Users, menus and site settings — the three screens you touch every day, included with the framework.
home.intg.title: Fits the tools you already run
home.intg.sub: Sign-in, storage, alerting, and automation speak standard protocols. You don't have to replace your infrastructure.
home.market.title: Add capabilities as plugins
home.market.sub: Delivered as source: browse, download, install from the admin. Pro plugins activate as soon as the license is imported.

home.editorial.platform.title:
The shared core,
built in.
home.editorial.platform.sub: Multi-tenancy, RBAC and data scopes, enterprise sign-in, audit and monitoring — the shared plumbing of accounts, permissions and files ships ready to run, and ready to replace.
home.editorial.extension.title:
Extend everything
around your business.
home.editorial.extension.sub: Source plugins, open APIs, file exports and i18n: keep business code in your own area, plug shared capabilities in through extension points, and upgrades stay clean.
home.editorial.intg.head: Standard protocols in, no re-plumbing of the infrastructure you already run.
